comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
They are. The Hufu for example is this one: Hufu

All #2 EA dungeon albums record the dungeon dropped equipment, some of which come treasure chests in ordinary floors and some (Gao qiang lu and Monk's Robe) can only be obtained from hidden passage treasure rooms.

Here's a partial MA screenshot for comparison: uliveto.blog72.fc2.com/blog-entry-1800.html

Cheers, and thanks for the help.

comments.author: Bael
comments.body: When you add a list like this you need to copy the link that corresponds to the item you want to show, per example, you just copied the first Hufu on the list that was DBLINK:00041000 for the Hufu, but on that list will show a link to all versions, the link you wanted is DBLINK:00041002, for the proper item Hufu, hope this helps. cheers.
